profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Web Developer, passionate about web technology and programming.  Highly capable problem solver with a focus on goals and exceeding them. Able to communicate well with teams and provide motivation. 

The value I will bring to an organization includes a strong skill set I have developed through my academic and work-related experiences. I am well-versed in front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I also have experience with some modern front-end libraries and frameworks like React, Vue, and jQuery while having proficiency in back-end technologies like Node JS and Express. In previous roles, I have contributed to positive improvements and team achievements through my problem-solving and collaboration abilities.

Here is a snapshot of some of my most relevant skills and qualifications:
 
Programming Languages: HTML, CSS, JavaScript.  CSS Preprocessors (Sass), Java, Python
Frameworks & Libraries: Node, Express, React, jQuery, Angular, React Native, Redux.
Software: Git, GitHub. Beginner: Sketch, Illustrator, Photoshop, 
Databases: SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB

• Used Node JS, Express, and PostgreSQL to build RESTful APIs as the company migrated from WordPress CMS; improving flexibility and scalability
• Assisted with hiring; building development team through interviewing new interns and performing evaluations of interns; improving progress toward company mission

• Worked together with CEO to enhance company’s existing WordPress legacy website, making it more up-to-date, and transforming it into a full-stack web application through React, Node, and Express
• Architected APIs featuring user authentication; storing, deleting, and updating data in the database

projects.title: CODR Blog
projects.description:
Inspired by the Dev.to a blogging platform, I wanted to create a web application, using the amazing Firebase service. So I wanted to create my own little version of the blogging platform called CODR. This is where coders, like myself, can share their thoughts with everyone.

Technologies used:

React.js
Next.js
Yarn
Sanity.io
TailwindCSS
Firebase

Github: https://github.com/klavenjones/CodrBlog

projects.title: CEMS Portfolio Website
projects.description: Cirius Engineering, L.L.C. is an up-and-coming electrical design consultancy agency. The company needed a way to promote the work and services they offer. The solution was to create a simple portfolio website, with standard front-end technologies, such as HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
